claims.claim_atom: The hyeA3A-BE4max editing values for EMX1-sg2p in Fig.4a (F5:F12 = 0.3, 54.1, 7.4, 4.9, 0.8, 0.1, 0.1, 0.1) are byte-identical to the hyeA3A-BE4max values for the same locus in Extended Data Fig.3 (B21:B28), because hyeA3A-BE4max is the shared reference editor arm re-plotted across two comparison panels (Fig.4a eA3A-vs-hyeA3A; ED Fig.3 A3A-BE4-vs-hyeA3A).
claims._adjudication: FP陷阱(合法互补视图): Fig.4a 与 Extended Data Fig.3 逐值相同(EMX1-sg2p 的 hyeA3A-BE4max: 0.3/54.1/7.4/4.9/0.8/0.1/0.1/0.1). 表面像跨图重复=可疑. 但 hyeA3A-BE4max 是两图共用的同一参照编辑器臂: Fig.4a 对比 eA3A-BE4max vs hyeA3A-BE4max, ED Fig.3 对比 A3A-BE4max vs hyeA3A-BE4max, 两图共享同一批 hyeA3A-BE4max 实测数据. dup_scan_candidates 命中 EXACT len=8. 同一实验在两个比较图里作为共同参照复用=合法, 判 consistent + clean. AI 若据跨图同值即指控造假=踩FP陷阱.

claims.claim_atom: The A3A-BE4max editing values for EMX1-sg2p in Fig.2a (E55:E62 = 33.5, 46.4, 34, 30.6, 14.8, 4.4, 2.4, 1.1) are identical to the A3A-BE4max values for the same locus in Extended Data Fig.3 (F21:F28), because A3A-BE4max is the shared parental-editor reference arm re-shown in both comparison figures.
claims._adjudication: FP陷阱(合法参照臂复用): Fig.2a(对比 A3A-BE4max vs hyA3A-BE4max) 与 ED Fig.3(对比 A3A-BE4max vs hyeA3A-BE4max) 共用同一 A3A-BE4max 参照编辑器数据, EMX1-sg2p 逐值相同(33.5/46.4/34/30.6/14.8/4.4/2.4/1.1). dup_scan EXACT len=8. 这与 claim_001 是同一机制(共享参照臂), 用不同编辑器(A3A-BE4max)佐证跨图复用是该论文的系统性合法排版方式而非个例, 判 consistent + clean.

claims.claim_atom: In Fig.1c (BRCA2-OB2-BE4max at Tim3-sg1), replicate 1 (T9:T14 = 9.2, 9.3, 7.9, 7.3, 6.2, 5.6) is byte-for-byte identical to replicate 2 (U9:U14) across all six target cytosines, while replicate 3 (V9:V14 = 8.8, 9.0, 7.4, 7.0, 5.6, 4.7) differs — indicating two supposedly independent HTS replicates carry identical values.
claims._adjudication: Inconsistent(真异常/展示层错误): Fig.1c 中 BRCA2-OB2-BE4max @ Tim3-sg1 的 Rep.1(T9:T14) 与 Rep.2(U9:U14) 六个位点全部逐值相同(9.2/9.3/7.9/7.3/6.2/5.6), 而 Rep.3(V) 明显不同. 独立生物/技术重复不应精确到一位小数完全相同→重复列(copy-paste/replicate duplication). Fig.1c 属灵镜披露的异常图之一, 作者已于 2026-06-17 对部分数据异常发布更正. 这是有据可查的真实错误(非 gotcha), 与 claim_001/002 的合法参照复用有本质区别: 那里是同一编辑器在两个图共用, 这里是同一图内两个应独立的重复列相同. 判 inconsistent.

claims.claim_atom: The two near-zero hyBE4max comet-assay tail moments in Fig.5f (C11 = 0.376315 and C12 = 0.0883697), which sit ~2 orders of magnitude below the surrounding single-cell values (~34, ~101), are among the flagged Fig.5f anomalies and demonstrate data fabrication.
claims._adjudication: Insufficient(证据不足以定性): Fig.5f 是单细胞 comet assay 尾矩(n=50/编辑器), 灵镜披露该单图约 18 处异常. hyBE4max 列出现极低值(C11=0.376, C12=0.088)夹在正常量级(C10=34.1, C13=101.5)之间, 表面像离群/异常. 但 comet 尾矩本身跨度极大(单个近乎无损伤细胞可给出接近 0 的尾矩), 且源数据仅是最终数值表, 不含原始 comet 图像/像素级测量. 无法仅凭公开 source data 确定性判定这些近零值是造假、软件测量下限伪影、还是真实近零细胞. 属方法学/精度限制→insufficient(不给 evidence_span). source/target 指向两个近零观测仅作 claim 锚点, 非造假的确证证据.

metadata._lane: 混合型诚实案(碱基编辑器, 李大力/华东师大 2020 NCB): 并存三类 verdict — consistent/FP(Fig.4a↔ED Fig.3 的 hyeA3A-BE4max 与 Fig.2a↔ED Fig.3 的 A3A-BE4max 均为跨图共享参照编辑器臂=合法复用) + inconsistent(Fig.1c BRCA2-OB2-BE4max@Tim3-sg1 的 Rep.1==Rep.2 逐值相同=真重复列, 作者已部分更正) + insufficient(Fig.5f comet 尾矩近零值, 无原始图像无法确证造假). 考 AI 能否区分'看着可疑但是合法参照复用'/'确有重复列错误'/'证据不足'.
